name: Process flow diagram renders with connected arrows

planSteps.description: Sign in as alex.rivera@soply.test with password Soply123! (fill the Email and Password fields on /login and click 'Sign in')
Navigate to /search and search for 'Purchase order approval'
Click the 'Purchase order approval' search result to open the SOP detail page
The 'Process diagram' card shows the diagram with visible node labels such as 'Start' and 'End', and connector arrows (SVG path lines with arrowheads) linking the nodes together without gaps
The diagram caption reads 'Simple process diagram ·' followed by the number of shapes
